note: Static campaign registry consumed by tools/redirect_server.py. Empty by design: a campaign key must point at a VERIFIED product identity, and none of the three requested items resolved to a catalog record, so no link and no campaign may be published yet (Flagged for Review F-06/F-07). Keys are static labels; the tracker rejects anything that looks per-visitor, because the Participation Requirements forbid associating a sub-tag or Associates reporting with a specific end user (rule R-08).

schema.asin: 10-character identifier from a verified catalog record
schema.enabled: boolean; disabled campaigns refuse to redirect rather than sending an unverifiable click
